name: KasaGo – Gestionale Immobiliare
author: kasago

sections.description:
KasaGo is the official plugin to connect your WordPress website with the KasaGo – Gestionale Immobiliare platform.

Thanks to the native API integration, any changes made to properties on KasaGo (descriptions, technical data, and photos) are synchronized in real time to your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Instant Synchronization: Automatically publish and update listings without having to re-enter them manually.
  • Gallery Management: Automatic download and media sync with KasaGo.
  • Mortgage Calculator: Includes a dedicated shortcode to display a customized mortgage calculator widget on your pages (FREE).

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin requires an active account on the KasaGo platform to function and synchronize data.

To connect the plugin, you need to generate an API key inside your KasaGo dashboard and paste it into the plugin configuration page in WordPress.

  • Privacy Policy: https://kasago.it/privacy
sections.faq:
Do I need a KasaGo account to use this plugin?

Yes, the plugin acts as a connector between the KasaGo CRM and your WordPress site. However, you can add the mortgage calculator to any page on your site for free without creating a KasaGo account.

Does the plugin work with real estate themes and Page Builders?

Yes, properties are stored in a standard Custom Post Type with dedicated metadata (kasago_gallery, etc.), making them fully compatible with Avada, Elementor, Divi, and the Gutenberg block editor.

How do I insert the mortgage calculator?

You can insert the widget on any page, post, or widget area using the shortcode:
[kasago_mutuo]
